free_text: Decision to defer biopsy for a 79-year-old man with PI-RADS 4, PSA 9.1 ng/mL, PSA density 0.161 and a prior biopsy status of 'Positive'. The panel protocol settled it by the rule 'cohort criterion (age_ge_78)' (EXPERT-COHORT); It matched the reading urologist in 2 of 2 labelled cases in exactly this situation (prior positive biopsy). The conference did not return a readable structured form, so this record was completed from the minute alone; no finding is asserted beyond the values in it.
